rules.statement: The Land Commissioner's authority to acquire land under the Land Redemption Ordinance depends on his satisfaction that the land was sold or transferred in certain specified circumstances, and not necessarily on those circumstances themselves.
rules.supporting_quote: The Land Commissioner's authority under the Land Redemption Ordinance to acquire an agricultural land depends not on its having been sold or transferred in the circumstances specified in section 3 (1) but upon his being satisfied that it has been so sold or transferred.
